title: CIM The Pitch 2027 — Design the Loop
summary: Develop a commercially viable circular brand and go-to-market strategy.
eligibility: International university students, including India, in a marketing / business degree containing a marketing module; year rules apply.

prize.description: Industry feedback, recognition and career-development benefits; current cash prizes not established.

notes: Free, fully virtual. First proposal due 16 November at 17:30 IST; final presentation due 25 January 2027.
An engineering / physics degree does not automatically meet the academic requirement.
